## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The legacy fetcher should honor the three-attempt retry cap because its eight-attempt loop prolongs blocked calls during an upstream outage.

## Changes
Adds a legacy inventory fetcher, an inventory health probe, and tests for success, HTTP errors, and retry exhaustion. It also proposes exempting legacy modules from the retry cap.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/legacy/fetch.py:7 — correctness — Limit the legacy fetcher to three attempts — When the legacy endpoint remains unavailable, you make eight attempts, violating `docs/review-rules.md:5`: “Code that retries a network call must stop after at most 3 attempts.” — During an outage, callers can wait through eight ten-second connection timeouts and seven one-second sleeps before receiving the error.
